hyperedges.description: Three-tier layered architecture: app orchestrates modules which depend on core interfaces
Master data (item, partner) ground quote and shipment. Inventory tracks all movements. History aggregates all changes.

nodes.label: Technical Stack
nodes.rationale: Object Pascal with Free Pascal + Lazarus toolchain for cross-platform compatibility and zero-cost tooling. Firebird database with in-memory fallback for zero-installation deployment.

nodes.label: Memory Mode
nodes.rationale: Database-agnostic data access through provider interfaces. Enables immediate execution without DB setup for evaluation, demo, and early development.

nodes.label: Layered Architecture
nodes.rationale: Three-tier separation: app shell, domain modules, and core interfaces/providers. Modules depend only on core interfaces, not implementations.

nodes.label: Data Access Abstraction
nodes.rationale: Interface-based repository pattern with swappable Memory and Firebird implementations. Enables provider-agnostic module code.

nodes.label: Item CRUD Operations
nodes.rationale: Support full lifecycle: list, search, create, update, delete. Validation enforces required fields and prevents duplicate codes.

nodes.label: Partner CRUD Operations
nodes.rationale: Support lifecycle management with kind-based filtering (customer/supplier). Validation includes business ID format checking and code uniqueness.

nodes.label: Stock Movements
nodes.rationale: Support three movement types: inbound (positive), outbound (negative), adjustment. Negative stock warnings allow informed decisions.

nodes.label: Quote Amount Calculation
nodes.rationale: Automatic line totals from quantity and unit price. Subtotal, 10% VAT, and grand total recalculated on input change.

nodes.label: Shipment Inventory Deduction
nodes.rationale: Shipment.Add internally calls Inventory.Move to decrement stock. Stock shortage warning allows override for exceptional cases.

nodes.label: History Read-Only Query
nodes.rationale: Unified view of inventory moves, shipments, and quotes. No mutations; read-only access through IHistoryRepository.

nodes.label: Identifier and Comment Conventions
nodes.rationale: English identifiers (classes, variables, methods) for universal readability. Korean comments and UI labels for developer convenience in Korean-speaking team.
